decision: Insert sparse hierarchy storage and large-world compaction as TQP-42, then shift former TQP-42 through TQP-64 to TQP-43 through TQP-65 so execution remains ground-up and sequential.
reason: TQP-30 qualifies finite balanced-octree selection but explicitly excludes large hierarchy storage. TQP-40 qualifies bounded residency, TQP-41 qualifies only a 44-page persistence fixture, and TQP-F002 proves that the 299,520-page reference cannot use the current production snapshot path. Fault injection, visual review, soak, and Gate E must not proceed while the authoritative hierarchy and persistence representation remain unqualified at the retained large-world scale.
alternatives_considered: treat TQP-30 octree selection as proof of efficient native storage
fold storage scalability into TQP-45 performance soak after fault injection and visual review
append storage as TQP-65 despite its earlier dependency position
mandate an octree without comparing it with equivalent sparse or implicit hierarchy representations
evidence: TQP-30 adaptive_lod_standard explicitly leaves unbounded or planet-scale hierarchy storage unqualified
world-transvoxel WtBalancedLodPlanner retains a sorted complete page-catalog vector and uses binary-search membership
world-transvoxel procedural key generation materializes every declared hierarchy page
world-transvoxel production snapshot storage is bounded to 4,096 pages while the manifest and procedural ceilings are 524,288 pages
TQP-F002 records deterministic large-volume compaction rejection for the retained 299,520-page 2048x256x2048-cell reference
TQP-41 qualifies compaction and migration only for a retained 44-page native-baked hierarchy
required_contract: octree or equivalent sparse hierarchy chosen by correctness and measured cost
deterministic page, ancestor, child, neighbor, range, and viewer-root queries
separate declared-catalog, sparse-index, edit-overlay, cache, and resident memory accounting
no mandatory all-page materialization on runtime hot paths
large-world compaction, reopen, edit replay, migration, and atomic failure evidence
predeclared startup, lookup, traversal, update, bytes-per-page, peak-memory, and compaction budgets
focused editor observatory for hierarchy and storage behavior
explicit_non_claims: no TQP-42 qualification is created by this roadmap decision
no octree implementation is selected in advance
TQP-F002 remains open until the retained large-world evidence passes
no production, GPU, networking, or planet-scale storage claim
standards_changed: qualification-state and blocker identifiers through TQP-65
downstream_impact: TQP-42 is the sole next dependency-ordered milestone. Former fault injection is TQP-43, visual review is TQP-44, adaptive soak is TQP-45, Gate E is TQP-46, and all later unqualified work shifts by one without changing status or claim scope.
